mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 5.33% is below the 5.5% threshold historically associated with positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS = 5.33%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity market valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal accelerating inflation and policy tightening, triggering equity market risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and business investment, supporting equity market gains and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals manufacturing contraction and potential economic slowdown, triggering safe-haven demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS signal accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market conditions, supporting equity market gains and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, supporting equity market gains and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
